parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy search by workspace name is supported.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100.
Default value: 20.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The workspace type. Valid values:

- system: public workspace

- self: custom workspace

- shared: shared workspace

- community: community workspace

By default, all workspaces are returned.
